# endpointcentral_script (Resource)

A script in the Script Repository, for `endpointcentral_mac_custom_script`.

Uses the calls Endpoint Central's console makes, which need the `DesktopCentralCloud.Common.CREATE` scope besides the Configurations scopes. The API does not return a script's content, so `content` changes made in the console are not detected; description, exit codes and default arguments are read back. Endpoint Central refuses to delete a script that a configuration still uses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A script kept in Git, added to the Script Repository. Changes to the file
# are uploaded as a new version of the same script.
resource "endpointcentral_script" "computer_name" {
  name               = "set-computer-name.sh"
  content            = file("${path.module}/scripts/set-computer-name.sh")
  description        = "Sets the computer name from a prefix and the serial number"
  success_exit_codes = [0]
}

resource "endpointcentral_script" "cleanup" {
  name     = "cleanup-tmp.sh"
  platform = "linux"
  content  = <<-EOT
    #!/bin/sh
    find /tmp -type f -mtime +7 -delete
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The script itself, e.g. `file("scripts/set-computer-name.sh")`.
- `name` (String) File name, e.g. `set-computer-name.sh`. Changing it replaces the script.

### Optional

- `default_arguments` (String, Sensitive) Arguments the console fills in when the script is picked. Readable by anyone who can list the Script Repository, so keep secrets out of it.
- `description` (String) Script description.
- `platform` (String) `mac` (default), `linux` or `windows`. Changing it replaces the script.
- `shared` (Boolean) Share the script with other technicians. Default `false`.
- `success_exit_codes` (Set of Number) Exit codes that count as success. Default `[0]`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of `content`.
- `id` (String) Script ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import takes the script ID. The content cannot be read back, so the next
# apply uploads the configured content once.
tofu import endpointcentral_script.computer_name 123456789012345
```
